newsitem.title: INDIA: India supports U.N. peace moves in Afghanistan.
newsitem.headline: India supports U.N. peace moves in Afghanistan.

text.p: The Indian government on Saturday offered to support United Nations peace efforts in Afghanistan, a Foreign Ministry statement said.

"India supports the efforts of the United Nations Secretary General and his special representative in bringing peace to Afghanistan," the statement said. It was New Delhi's first official reaction since purist Islamist Taleban militia took charge of Kabul nearly two weeks ago.
India was prepared to play a part in international moves to broker peace in Afghanistan, the ministry said.
But it said that cessation of foreign interference was necessary for a resolution of conflict in Afghanistan.
The statement said India was deeply concerned at the Afghan situation and expressed saddness at the loss of life and continued violence.

"The imposition of a harsh and fundamentalist ideology, which is contrary to the traditional ethos of Afghanistan, has raised serious misgivings about the human rights situation, especially the rights of women, in Afghanistan," it said.
